item.title: refactor(ui): one token formatter — the same count no longer renders …
item.summary: refactor(ui): one token formatter — the same count no longer renders two ways (#123472) The UI carried three token formatters with proven divergence: 15,600 rendered as 16k on the Sessions page (formatTokens) but 15.6k in the chat composer and /usage (formatCompactTokenCount); 999,600 as 1.0M vs 999.6k. The message-meta cost line also bypassed formatCost with a hardcoded toFixed(4), showing $1.2346 next to a popover showing $1.23. formatCompactTokenCount is now the one owner: it absorbs formatTokens' nullish fallback and model-providers' local billion-suffix wrapper (both deleted), and the message cost line goes through formatCost. Production net −19.
